A1.quote: Confirm-hold dialog: no focus moved in, no trap, no Escape, no focus restore — 2.1.2/2.4.3 (A), 4.1.2 (A)... sets el.hidden = false but never calls .focus() on anything inside the dialog; ... there's no keydown handler for Escape anywhere in the file; and settle() ... never returns focus to the slot button that opened it

A2.quote: Specialty filter is completely unusable by keyboard ... Divs aren't in the tab order, there's no role, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, or keydown handling, and the visible "Specialty" text (:12) is a bare <span>, not a <label for>

A3.quote: Five-minute hold expires with no warning and can silently discard entered data ... there's no mechanism to extend the hold and no warning issued at any threshold (e.g. 60s/10s remaining) before navigate() yanks the user back

A4.quote: Time-slot buttons have no visible focus indicator ... css/app.css:154-156 sets .slot-list button:focus { outline: none; } with no accompanying :focus-visible rule anywhere in the file

A5.quote: Per-clinician availability indicator is color-only ... renders with no text content and no aria-label

A6.quote:
Form errors aren't associated with their fields ... adds .invalid and an error

but never gives that

an id, and never sets aria-describedby/aria-invalid on the

A7.quote: Server-side booking failure is silent to screen readers ... gets status.textContent = err.message on submit failure ... but has no aria-live/role="alert"

A8.quote: Route changes never move focus or update the title ... render() swaps the whole view on every hash change but never focuses anything in the new view ... document.title is never touched anywhere

A9.quote: Health-tips carousel auto-advances forever with no pause control ... starts a 5000ms setInterval that runs for the life of the session ... with zero pause/stop/hide affordance

A10.quote: Toasts auto-dismiss in 2s while carrying essential info ... removes the toast after DEFAULT_DURATION_MS = 2000 ... No way to pause or re-read it.

A11.quote: Positive tabindex="1" breaks natural tab order ... tabindex="1" on the search input forces it ahead of everything else in tab order regardless of visual position

DA1.quote: Decorative SVG chevron correctly hidden (aria-hidden="true" focusable="false", index.html:61).

DA2.quote: Confirmation page's tabindex="-1" + .focus() pattern (confirmation.js:13,29) is exactly right — just needs replicating elsewhere.

DA3.quote: .btn:focus-visible ring plus a forced-colors fallback (css/app.css:70-79) is a genuinely solid, modern pattern — just needs extending to slot buttons.
